_meta.notes: Deduplicated URL registry compiled from canonical_facts.json, mechanisms.json, common_myths.json, product_angles.json, and entities.json. Tiers: A = peer-reviewed primary literature / official guidelines / WHO/NIH, B = university labs / respected experts, C = mainstream medical explainers, D = Thai official bodies.
